items.title: Earth from Space: The pink city
items.summary: Image: This image shows a detailed view of the city of Toulouse in southwest France, with its terracotta tiled rooftops lending it the nickname la ville rose, or the pink city.

items.title: Earth from Space: West Antarctica
items.summary: Image: This image over part of West Antarctica was captured by Copernicus Sentinel-3 on 30 September 2026.

items.title: Gibraltar imaged by IRIDE Eaglet II
items.summary: Image: While the final eight IRIDE Eaglet II satellites were launched a week ago, the first images from Eaglet II satellites launched earlier are being returned, including a view of Gibraltar featured here.
